description: This file defines a Zustand store hook 'useUIStore' that manages global UI state such as theme, sidebar visibility, loading status, and banner notifications.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the current UI theme (e.g., 'light' or 'dark').

methods.name: setGlobalLoading
methods.description: Sets the global loading indicator to true, false, or other truthy/falsy values.

methods.name: showBanner
methods.description: Displays a banner with specified type and message.
